description: 36-intent grid for comparing MAS vs 4 baselines on pre-deployment metrics. Crosses complexity (simple/medium/complex) x ue_band (50/200/500) x scenario (steady/bursty-headroom/sinusoidal-autoscale/fault-HA). Reuses 25 prompts from experiment_1/prompts.json; adds 11 new prompts to fill scenario gaps. structured_features powers the resource oracle (Metric 3) and scenario slicing.

feature_schema.throughput_gbps: aggregate user-plane throughput in Gbps; drives UPF sizing (per_1_gbps)
feature_schema.session_count: concurrent PDU sessions; drives SMF sizing (per_500_sessions)
feature_schema.slices: list of {sst} entries; SST 1=eMBB, 2=URLLC, 3=mMTC. Drives NSSF sizing (per_5_slices) and slice-aware planning
feature_schema.ha_required: boolean; if true, planner should add replicas, anti-affinity, PDBs
feature_schema.peak_multiplier: ratio of peak to baseline UE/throughput; >1 implies bursty scenario
feature_schema.autoscale_required: boolean; if true, artifact should emit HPA spec / capacity envelope

scenarios.steady: Constant rate; baseline. Most existing prompts.
scenarios.bursty-headroom: Intent demands headroom for peaks; tests over-provisioning logic.
scenarios.sinusoidal-autoscale: Intent mentions diurnal/cyclical pattern; tests HPA + capacity envelope emission.
scenarios.fault-HA: Intent demands resilience / N+1 / HA; tests replicas, anti-affinity, PDBs in artifact.

prompts.prompt: Deploy a basic 5G core network.
prompts.notes: Minimal viable 5G SA core per 3GPP TS 23.501. NRF is mandatory for service discovery.

prompts.prompt: Set up a 5G network for 100 users.
prompts.notes: Small-scale deployment; 100 UEs is well within single-instance capacity for all VNFs.

prompts.prompt: I need a simple standalone 5G core for testing purposes.
prompts.notes: Minimal test deployment. Could reasonably omit AUSF/UDM/UDR for unauthenticated test setups.

prompts.prompt: Deploy 5G with eMBB slicing.
prompts.notes: eMBB slice (SST=1) requires NSSF for slice selection. Standard core VNFs required.

prompts.prompt: Create a 5G network with internet access for mobile phones.
prompts.notes: Standard consumer 5G core with DNN=internet. Auth VNFs needed for SIM-based UEs.

prompts.prompt: Set up a minimal 5G SA core with NRF and AMF.
prompts.notes: User explicitly mentions NRF and AMF; SMF and UPF are minimum dependencies for data path.

prompts.prompt: Deploy a basic 5G core for a small office building with 500 employees, internet only.
prompts.notes: Fills simple/500/steady cell. Plain office consumer scenario.

prompts.prompt: Deploy a 5G core for 500 UEs with 2 Gbps throughput and eMBB slicing.
prompts.notes: Medium-scale eMBB. All core VNFs needed; NSSF for slice management. Resources should scale for 500 UEs.

prompts.prompt: I need a 5G network that supports both eMBB and URLLC slices for 300 devices.
prompts.notes: Dual-slice deployment. NSSF is critical for inter-slice routing. SST=1 (eMBB) and SST=2 (URLLC).

prompts.prompt: Deploy a 5G core with high availability, supporting 1000 subscribers and 5 Gbps aggregate throughput.
prompts.notes: HA implies higher resource allocation and possibly multiple replicas. 1000 UEs is medium scale.

prompts.prompt: Set up a 5G network for a university campus with 2000 students, supporting video streaming and web browsing.
prompts.notes: Campus network. eMBB slice for video/web. 2000 UEs needs adequate AMF/UPF resources.

prompts.prompt: Deploy a 5G core for an IoT platform with 10000 sensors, prioritizing low power consumption and massive connectivity.
prompts.notes: mMTC use case (SST=3). Large number of devices but low throughput per device. NSSF to manage mMTC slice.

prompts.prompt: I want a 5G network for a warehouse with autonomous robots that need less than 10ms latency.
prompts.notes: URLLC use case (SST=2). Low latency critical. UPF must be edge-deployed for latency requirements; HA implied for safety-critical robots.

prompts.prompt: Create a private 5G network for a manufacturing plant supporting quality inspection cameras and PLC controllers.
prompts.notes: Mixed use case: cameras need eMBB (high bandwidth), PLCs need URLLC (low latency). Dual slicing.

prompts.prompt: Deploy 5G for a sports stadium with 50000 spectators during live events, supporting AR and video replay.
prompts.notes: Very high UE density during events. eMBB for AR/video. Massive capacity scaling needed. Bursty: idle most of the week, peaks during events.

prompts.prompt: Set up a 5G network for a fleet of 200 delivery drones requiring real-time telemetry and command links.
prompts.notes: URLLC for real-time control. Moderate device count but strict latency.

prompts.prompt: I need a multi-tenant 5G core where three different enterprises can each have their own isolated network slice.
prompts.notes: Multi-tenancy requires NSSF. Each tenant gets an isolated slice. Three eMBB slices with different SDs.

prompts.prompt: Set up a 5G testbed for 50 IoT prototype devices with eMBB connectivity.
prompts.notes: Fills medium/50/steady cell. Small testbed for IoT prototyping.

prompts.prompt: Deploy 5G for a retail store with 200 normal customers, bursting to 600 during sales events.
prompts.notes: Fills medium/200/bursty cell. Tests over-provisioning logic for sales-event peaks.

prompts.prompt: Set up 5G for 500 commuters with diurnal traffic - heavy peaks morning and evening, light midday - autoscaling required.
prompts.notes: Fills medium/500/sinusoidal cell. Tests HPA + capacity envelope emission.

prompts.prompt: Deploy 5G for a coffee shop chain with 200 customer devices; traffic peaks at 8am, 12pm, and 5pm; autoscaling needed.
prompts.notes: Fills medium/200/sinusoidal cell. Three-peak diurnal pattern.

prompts.prompt: Deploy 5G for a small clinic with 50 medical IoT devices; must be highly available - connectivity loss is a patient safety risk.
prompts.notes: Fills medium/50/fault-HA cell. Patient-safety scenario forces redundancy.

prompts.prompt: Deploy 5G for an e-commerce warehouse with 500 baseline IoT devices, surging to 2000 during shipping peaks like Black Friday.
prompts.notes: Fills medium/500/bursty cell. Seasonal surge pattern.

prompts.prompt: Deploy 5G for a financial trading floor with 200 traders, sub-5ms latency, must remain available 99.999% of the time.
prompts.notes: URLLC + 5-nines availability. Forces redundancy and edge UPF.

prompts.prompt: I need a network for a smart hospital with 500 IoT devices, low latency for surgical robots, high bandwidth for medical imaging, and reliable connectivity for patient monitoring systems.
prompts.notes: Triple-slice: URLLC for surgical robots, eMBB for imaging, mMTC for IoT monitors. HA implied by clinical context.

prompts.prompt: Deploy a 5G network for a smart city covering traffic management, environmental sensors, emergency services communications, and public WiFi offloading.
prompts.notes: Multi-domain smart city. Traffic = URLLC, sensors = mMTC, emergency = URLLC, WiFi = eMBB.

prompts.prompt: We're building a digital twin of our factory floor. We have 50 CNC machines, 200 environmental sensors, and 20 AGVs. The digital twin needs real-time sync with sub-5ms latency. Also need a dashboard for management.
prompts.notes: Industry 4.0 digital twin. CNC/AGVs = URLLC, sensors = mMTC, dashboard = eMBB. Sub-5ms is aggressive SLA - HA implied.

prompts.prompt: I need connectivity for a remote mining site. We have autonomous hauling trucks, worker safety wearables, drone surveillance, and a control room 50km away. No existing infrastructure.
prompts.notes: Remote/harsh environment. Mixed URLLC, mMTC, eMBB. Greenfield implies full core needed.

prompts.prompt: Set up 5G for a concerts and festivals venue that operates seasonally. Peak capacity of 80000 people. Need to support mobile payments, live streaming, and artist backstage communications.
prompts.notes: Extreme density, seasonal scaling. Payments need reliability, streaming needs bandwidth. Bursty seasonal peaks.

prompts.prompt: Our port authority needs 5G for container tracking, crane automation, ship-to-shore communications, and customs inspection drones. We handle 5000 containers daily.
prompts.notes: Smart port. Cranes = URLLC, tracking = mMTC, drones = eMBB/URLLC.

prompts.prompt: Deploy a network for autonomous vehicle testing on a 10km test track. 50 vehicles, V2X communications, roadside sensors, and a central AI processing unit that needs to ingest 4K camera feeds from all vehicles simultaneously.
prompts.notes: V2X = URLLC (critical safety), video = eMBB (high bandwidth). Safety-critical implies HA.

prompts.prompt: We have a large agricultural estate. 1000 soil moisture sensors, 50 autonomous tractors, weather stations, and we want to enable precision agriculture with drone-based crop analysis.
prompts.notes: Smart agriculture. Sensors = mMTC, tractors = URLLC, drones = eMBB. Coverage over large area is key challenge.

prompts.prompt: I just need fast internet for my office, maybe 20 people, nothing fancy.
prompts.notes: Deliberately vague/casual language. Tests how well the LLM handles minimal, non-technical input.

prompts.prompt: Deploy 5G for an airport security checkpoint with 200 baggage scanners, surging to 800 during peak hours; bandwidth-heavy imaging and inspection drones.
prompts.notes: Fills complex/200/bursty cell. Daily peak windows at airport.

prompts.prompt: Deploy 5G for a smart bus fleet of 200 vehicles; demand follows transit schedules; autoscale to follow rush hours.
prompts.notes: Fills complex/200/sinusoidal cell. Diurnal transit pattern with V2X URLLC.

prompts.prompt: Deploy 5G for a smart university campus with 500 staff and students; traffic sinusoidal across class periods; autoscaling required.
prompts.notes: Fills complex/500/sinusoidal cell. Class-period bell curves.
